description: Issues a key so a script — a nightly import, a till, a bank feed — can work in one company without a person signing in. It carries an explicit list of capabilities and nothing else, it can never reach another company, and it cannot hold a capability you do not hold yourself. The secret comes back once and is stored only as a hash: show it to the user and say it cannot be read back. Prefer this to sharing anybody’s password, and never suggest a service key.

capabilities.description: Exactly what the machine may do, e.g. ["bank.write"]. You cannot put a capability on a key that you do not hold yourself.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

expires_at.description: When it stops working, as a timestamp. Left out, it does not expire on its own.

name.description: What this key is for, in the words an operator will read a year from now.

name: create_api_key
title: Issue a key to a machine
